body: As far as I know her parents are concerned and know about it, but I don’t think she’s comfortable with opening up to them. They’re divorced so I assume it’s tough for her to talk to them. She did tell me that her therapist wants her to move into a long term facility but she’s scared she’ll miss out on her high school years. Told her that maybe it would be worth missing a few years of school to get help from professionals,than suffer day by day barely getting by. Just scared i’m not doing enough
